programs.title: The Kimberley: Australia's Wild West
programs.desc: Bask in the largest intact savannah on the planet, where mammals and insects fly through the air with the greatest of ease. Study traditional wildfire-management methods, explore a sandstone refuge, and watch a sugar glider try to escape the flames.

director: Nick Robinson: Director, Mark Coles Smith: Narrator

programs.title: Wildlife ER
programs.desc: Stand by as rescue officers use a technique called flagging to nab a koala with dangerously inflamed eyes. Soothe burned possum feet with vet Tim, then shadow vet Karina as she examines a half-drowned platypus before referring him to a specialist.

director: Annie Gray: Series Producer, Justine Clark: Narrator

programs.title: Wildlife ER
programs.desc: Juggle the demands of caring for sick koala joeys with vet Claire, then see what it takes to save a squirrel glider caught in barbed wire. Take care of an exhausted owl and get a big surprise when vet Tim X-rays a turtle that was struck by a car.

director: Annie Gray: Series Producer, Justine Clark: Narrator

programs.title: Wildlife ER
programs.desc: Follow vet Tim as he races to save rescued koala Ashley, then meet a flying fox with an extra digit who needs some TLC from vet Martine. Calculate the odds for a run-over kangaroo joey with vet Emily, then celebrate the release of 50 lorikeets.

director: Annie Gray: Series Producer, Justine Clark: Narrator

programs.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride
programs.desc: Run into a lion-hyena showdown with Julz as he hunts for the elusive Manzi pack, who are missing four of their precious pups. Then join Henry from the Zambian Carnivore Programme on a house call to the Kakumbi den, where another pup has gone AWOL.

director: Jo Robinson: Series Producer, Jules Braatvedt: On-Screen DP & Narrator

programs.title: Carpathian Predators
programs.desc: Join a mother brown bear as she struggles to find food for her two young cubs while teaching them essential skills for the harsh winter ahead. Then visit a pair of tiny lynx kittens as they begin to venture away from the safety of their den.
